subtasks.description: Declare all persistent storage: state_matrix (4x4 bytes) as a flat reg vector, round_key_buffer (11x128-bit) as a flat reg vector, round_counter (dcnt) as an integer or reg, and fsm_state as a reg with encoding for operational phases. Include optional auxiliary flags if needed.
constraints: Flatten state_matrix into 16 scalar 8-bit registers or a flat 128-bit reg; no unpacked arrays or multidimensional references.
Flatten round_key_buffer into 11x128-bit scalar registers or a flat 1408-bit reg; no unpacked arrays or multidimensional references.

subtasks.description: Instantiate aes_key_expand and aes_inv_sbox as submodules, connecting clk, rst, key, text_in, and other necessary control and data signals per their interfaces.

Combinational network that computes next_state_comb from current state matrix and round key: apply InvShiftRows (byte reordering), InvSubBytes (via inv_sbox instance), AddRoundKey (XOR), and InvMixColumns (GF(2^8) matrix mult). Omit InvMixColumns when in FinalRound (indicated by round_counter).
constraints: All internal combinational signals and operations must be scalar; unroll byte-level loops explicitly without generate/genvar.
No sequential elements, latches, or pipelining; purely combinational.

subtasks.description: Sequential always block implementing FSM with phases: IDLE, KeyLoad, KeyExpansion, KeyStored, InitialRound, StandardRound, FinalRound, Done. Manage key expansion start/done handshake, sample key/text_in during KeyLoad, load round_key_buffer from key_expand outputs, increment round counter, and commit next_state_comb to state_matrix each round.
Registered output block: on posedge clk, load text_out from the final state_matrix (after FinalRound) and assert done when fsm_state is Done; reset both to zero on synchronous reset.
constraints: Assemble text_out from scalar state matrix registers without unpacked arrays; map each byte to the appropriate bit positions explicitly.
